verdict: Scale is the problem this week — efficiency held, volume did not.
narrative: This period, Google Ads ran zero spend on three separate days, which cut lead flow sharply and left the last three days of the week (Aug 5–7) with no leads at all. The good news is that your cost per lead held nearly flat at $217.78 — the ads are working when they run; the account simply was not fed enough budget to produce volume. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile actions also went quiet over the same three days, which tells us this is a broader demand-signal dip, not an isolated paid-media issue. We're restoring consistent daily spend and confirming your lead-intake coverage so that when leads do come in, they're being handled immediately. Next week you should see daily activity resume and lead counts recover from this week's floor.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days
cost per lead this period — nearly unchanged week over week

watch_item.issue: Lead intake coverage has a gap — the last several days produced zero leads in part because response workflows may not have an active owner.
watch_item.fix: We are confirming a confirmed intake owner and verifying that all lead-response automations are routing to an active contact before spend is scaled back up.
